summary: Complaints centre on jams at Khair mandi and broken roads near Khair town, and a shut registry office for 25 days; the Khair-Jattari road widening and a new CHC cooling ward are the main visible gains.

positives.english: Khair-Jattari road widening has started and people hope it will ease the jams
positives.hindi: खैर-जट्टारी मार्ग का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हुआ, जाम से राहत की उम्मीद
positives.basis: Article says construction began 13 April from Arrana Kante to Hamidpur Yamuna bridge, cost about Rs 88 crore, target one year; MLA inspected the work

positives.english: A four-bed cooling ward has been set up at Khair CHC for heatstroke patients
positives.hindi: खैर सीएचसी में लू से बचाव के लिए चार बेड का कूलिंग वार्ड बना है
positives.basis: Cooling ward built next to CHC emergency with four beds; CHC president said the heat relief room will run as a permanent arrangement

positives.english: Khair's registration office reopened after 25 days and registry work has resumed
positives.hindi: 25 दिन बंद रहा खैर का निबंधन कार्यालय, अब रजिस्ट्री फिर शुरू हुई
positives.basis: Registration work reopened on 3 July 2026 after the lawyers' protest ended; 120 registrations on the first day

positives.english: *A 10 km bypass on the Aligarh-Palwal road at Khair is proposed to ease jams
positives.hindi: *खैर में जाम से राहत के लिए अलीगढ़-पलवल मार्ग पर बाईपास का प्रस्ताव है
positives.basis: Inference: only a proposal awaiting board approval on 13 Aug 2026, not a started or completed project; included because no completed Khair-specific relief was found. Source gives 10 km, 35 m wide, about Rs 70 crore

positives.english: *A Rs 362 crore plan for 114 roads totalling 169 km is planned for Khair constituency
positives.hindi: *खैर की 114 सड़कों के लिए 169 किमी की योजना आई है
positives.basis: Inference: a plan figure from an Aligarh-division roads article, not confirmed as sanctioned or started; only the Khair constituency mention is Khair-specific

negatives.english: Five hours of jam at Khair mandi left school buses stuck and children reached school late
negatives.hindi: खैर मंडी में पांच घंटे जाम, स्कूल बसें फंसीं, बच्चे देर से पहुंचे
negatives.basis: Jam from about 4 AM on Friday 25 Sep 2026 at Khair mandi on the Aligarh-Palwal road lasted over five hours; private school managers said students were delayed 1.5 to 2 hours; CO said police were short-staffed; paddy arrivals rose because Igalas and Dhanipur mandis were closed

negatives.english: The road from the Pathwari temple to Somna bypass in Khair is badly broken
negatives.hindi: खैर में पथवारी मंदिर से सोमना बाईपास तक सड़क टूटी पड़ी है
negatives.basis: Article names the road from the historic Pathwari temple in Khair to Somna bypass as badly damaged, about one km, in poor condition for a long time; the article is district-wide (Aligarh division roads) but names Khair

negatives.english: Khair's registration office stayed shut for 25 days and registry work stopped
negatives.hindi: 25 दिन तक खैर का निबंधन कार्यालय बंद रहा, रजिस्ट्री का काम ठप रहा
negatives.basis: Khair tehsil registration work was shut 25 days; lawyers boycotted the office from 9 June 2026 in protest against privatisation of registration; reopened 3 July 2026

negatives.english: Khair mandi gets heavy jams during crop purchases; the DM asked for a token system and alternate vehicle routes
negatives.hindi: खैर मंडी में फसल खरीद के समय भारी जाम लगता है
negatives.basis: Mandi Samiti Khair (in Khair town, namesake rule). DM visited on 31 Oct 2025 and heard traders; jams during paddy, wheat and potato purchase; token system to be introduced and alternate vehicle routes asked for. Replaces the earlier millet item, which was tehsil-level and not AC-specific

negatives.english: Unannounced power cuts in the heat are troubling farmers, and they gave a memorandum at the substation
negatives.hindi: अघोषित बिजली कटौती से गर्मी में किसान परेशान, बिजलीघर पर ज्ञापन दिया
negatives.basis: District-level: farmers and villagers gave a memorandum at Jattari substation to the SDO, warning of protest; article gives no hours and names no village; does not name Khair; AC membership of Jattari unconfirmed

notes: AC 71 confirmed on the Wikipedia constituency list as Khair (SC), Aligarh district. The Wikipedia AC page (Khair Assembly constituency) gives constituency number 71, SC reservation, Aligarh district and 2012 electorate, but has no extent, tehsil or village list, so Khair town is treated as inside the AC under the namesake rule. Khair tehsil villages and blocks are not confirmed. Negatives 1, 2, 3 and 4 are Khair-town specific (mandi, Pathwari temple to Somna bypass road, tehsil registry office, Khair mandi purchase jams). Negative 5 (Jattari substation power cuts) is district-level and does not name Khair; AC membership of Jattari is unconfirmed, so it is not counted. Positives 4 and 5 are a proposed bypass awaiting board approval and a plan figure for 114 roads in Khair constituency; both are flagged as inference. No completed Khair-town benefit beyond the three in positives 1-3 was found. Positive 3 and negative 3 rest on the same article (registry closed, then reopened); this is one event seen from both sides. Positive 5 source names Khair constituency explicitly; the Pathwari road in negative 2 is named in the same article, which is district-wide. Patrika Khair memorandum (BKU Harpal faction, Tehsil Khair SDM) was re-checked: the page shows publication 16 Jul 2022, so it is not used. Excluded as electoral: the Jan 2026 Amar Ujala report on documents sought from 20,000 voters. Not used: Udayavani 2018 stray-cattle report (old), Amar Ujala Dec 2024 Anni village cow remains (old, village AC membership unconfirmed), and Khair Samadhan Diwas reports (dates or Khair-specific lines unverified). Searches this round (Khair town water, drainage, roads, CHC, encroachment and bus stand, power, Khair mandi 2026, Somna road) returned no further 2024-26 Khair-town items. Field check suggested: drinking water supply in Khair town, CHC staffing, stray cattle and gaushala status, whether Jattari substation serves AC 71 villages, and Khair mandi token system status.

round2.changes: Verified all 10 cited sources against the article text (dates and figures match). Replaced negative 4 (millet, tehsil-level, AC unconfirmed) with Khair mandi purchase jams (Amar Ujala 1 Nov 2025), making 4 AC-specific negatives. Checked Wikipedia AC page: no extent section. Re-checked Patrika Khair memorandum: 2022, not used. Summary reworded so the Jattari power-cut item is not presented as Khair-town. Notes rewritten.
